title: renewables account record 58 germanys power consumption h1 2026 07 01
text: BERLIN, July 1 (Reuters) - Renewable energy sources accounted for 58% ​of electricity consumption in ‌Germany in the first half of 2026, an increase ​of nearly 3 percentage ​points on the same ⁠period last year and ​a record, said the ​ZSW research centre and BDEW association on Wednesday.
